subtasks: Place all the objects into the box with their front sides facing left.
Move the empty box upright to the cleared center of the table with its long edges running left to right.
Place the white toy car on the box bottom along the back long edge, with its front pointing left and rear pointing right.
Set the tipped cardboard box upright again in the cleared center, with its opening up and its long edges running left to right.
Place the green shoe on the open box bottom beside the car, lengthwise with its toe pointing left and heel pointing right. Keep the car in place.
Release the shoe on the table. Pick up the hammer with the left hand, turn its metal head to the left, and place it lengthwise inside the box behind the car.
Grasp the middle of the shoe with the right hand, lift it over the box rim, and place it flat entirely inside the box with the toe left and heel right. Keep the car and hammer in place.

Hold the shoe clear in the right hand. Use the left gripper on the box's left flap to bring the box toward the middle of the table and turn it until the long edges run left to right. Keep the box upright and the contents inside.

Place the held shoe lengthwise in the free strip at the front of the box, toe left and heel right. Clear the low front rim, lower the shoe, release it and withdraw upward. Keep the car and hammer inside.

Lift the open right gripper clear of the box, pick up the toothbrush on the right, and pack it lengthwise in the box with the green brush head on the left. Release it and return both arms to their initial poses with both grippers open.
